plotSections.title: Helmet, influence, and the phylactery
bullets: Dana asks Glimmen, in Draconic, whether Walker has seemed odd since he started wearing the helmet everywhere, wanting a check that he is not being influenced.
Walker says that if Grixto is influencing either of them, it would be Glimmen.
Glimmen clamps her mouth around Walker's helmet, tells him mentally to give up the helmet, and lifts him by it. The grip hurts her. He refuses to give it to anyone except Carlkin, who may examine it.
Glimmen rests her head on him with real weight and asks whether phylacteries are flame resistant. She offers to torch the helmet. Walker says not necessarily and refuses.

Glimmen says Walker seems influenced, that she is unfit to diagnose it, and that his internal fire can spread and protect her through their bond. In Draconic she tells Dana he has not acted any stranger than normal, then says she should still light him on fire to see if it burns.

Sylan says that if the helmet is the phylactery they should not destroy it until they find its owner; if he senses it destroyed, he will make another. Walker agrees they need eyes on him. Sylan says they can still try to rule the helmet out.

plotSections.title: Fire, meditation, and a new trainer
bullets: Walker says he is fire resistant, not fireproof. Glimmen says that means he needs more training and that they are wasting time. Ciri starts a tinderbox under his arm.

Sylan tells Walker that Gerk has gotten a little better at manipulating doors but still needs practice. A man who looks half-elf, about 5'10" to 5'11", and who has an ancient copper-colored dragon, offers to train them both. He tells Walker to have the helmet investigated and then return to training.

He pokes Gerk in the midriff and says Gerk is strong of body but lacking in mind. He calls it no insult: one does not insult an oak while it is a sapling. He taps Gerk's chest and says the growth they want is in the mind.

He says Walker needs help meditating and asks if Gerk has done it. Dana explains it as quieting the mind, like the focus Gerk uses to open a door, because an unfocused door can open into the abyss. Gerk says that happens only if he thinks about nothing.

Dana says the party still needs Gerk's rage, properly channeled, and that the doors are a separate kind of focus. Gerk thinks opening a door while raging would go poorly. He says that with the seventeen-foot door he only tried to open it harder.

plotSections.title: Who goes to Carlkin
bullets: Sylan suggests an appointment with Carlkin today if Walker will not take the helmet off in front of the group. Gerk says not to walk in because Carlkin is in a bad way; Ord says he is not available. Sylan thinks Gerk should skip the visit and that he himself probably should too. Dana says both should stay home.

Sylan proposes that he and Gerk play good cop and bad cop while the others talk to Carlkin. Dana agrees, on the conditions that there be no doors to empty dimensions, no abyssal monsters, and no doors opened on moving vehicles. Ord asks how Gerk is supposed to be bad cop if he cannot threaten anyone.

Sylan heads for New Navel and asks Dana to warn Carlkin that they are returning today, because the party is not within 500 feet. Last time they had no appointment, barged in, opened a portal to the abyss, and Sylan broke Carlkin's floor.

chronologicalEvents: Dana asks Glimmen in Draconic for a sanity check on Walker and the helmet. Walker suggests Glimmen would be the one influenced by Grixto.
Glimmen seizes Walker's helmet in her mouth, demands he give it up, and lifts him by it. Walker says he will hand it only to Carlkin.

Glimmen asks if phylacteries are flame resistant and offers to burn the helmet. Walker refuses. She says he seems influenced, that she cannot diagnose it, and that his internal fire can protect her through their bond.
Glimmen tells Dana that Walker has not acted stranger than usual and that she still wants to light him on fire. She says he will be fine.
Sylan and Walker agree not to destroy a phylactery until they have eyes on its owner, while still trying to rule the helmet out.
Walker says he is fire resistant but not fireproof. Ciri lights a tinderbox under his arm. Glimmen says he needs more training.

The group plans a Carlkin visit. Gerk and Ord say Carlkin is in a bad way and not available. Dana tells Gerk and Sylan to stay home. Sylan instead proposes a good-cop/bad-cop errand, with Dana's ban on abyss doors and doors on moving vehicles.

Sylan reports Gerk's modest progress with doors. The half-elf-looking man with the ancient copper dragon volunteers to train Walker and Gerk, pokes Gerk, and frames him as a sapling whose mind must grow.

Dana explains meditation as door-focus. Gerk says the abyss result comes only from thinking of nothing, and that raging through a door would go badly. The seventeen-foot door, he says, was just him opening it harder.
Sylan asks Dana to notify Carlkin before they return to New Navel, citing the last unannounced visit, the abyss portal, and the broken floor.

notes: When Dana asks whether the helmet has changed Walker, Glimmen breaks off a reply, clamps her mouth around the helmet, and mentally orders Walker to give it up while lifting him by it. Doing so hurts her.
She presses the weight of her head onto him and asks whether phylacteries are flame resistant, then offers to torch the helmet.
She tells Walker he seems influenced, that she is unfit to diagnose mind control, and that his internal fire can spread and protect her because of their bond.
In Draconic to Dana, she says he has not acted any stranger than normal, then says she should still light him on fire and that he will be fine.
She treats his mere fire resistance, rather than being fireproof, as a sign he needs more training.
personality: Protective of the bond, and willing to burn the helmet to test it.
Unwilling to claim she can diagnose influence.
quotesThemes: Do you think phylacteries are flame resistant?
I could just torch the helmet.
Well he hasn't acted any stranger than normal.
I think I should still light him on fire and see if it burns.
That sounds like you need more training.

Walker.existing: Half-elf dragon rider and fighter, bonded to Glimmen.
notes: He refuses to give up the helmet and will hand it only to Carlkin for examination.
He says that if Grixto is influencing either of them, it would be Glimmen.
He agrees a phylactery should be destroyed only when they have eyes on its owner.
He says he is fire resistant, not fireproof. Glimmen says his internal fire can spread and protect her through the bond.
The trainer tells him to have the helmet investigated and then return to meditation training.
personality: Possessive of the helmet and unwilling to let the party or Glimmen take it.
Accepts the bond's shared fire and answers Glimmen with 'Hell yeah.'
quotesThemes: I ain't giving up my helmet. I'll let Carlkin examine it, but I will hand it to Carlkin.
This is my fucking helmet.
Not necessarily.
I am fire resistant. I don't think I'm fireproof yet.
We have to destroy it when we basically have eyes on him.

Helm.existing: A helm Carlkin agreed to examine by appointment.
notes: Walker has been wearing it everywhere, which is why Dana asks Glimmen for a sanity check.
Glimmen tries to pull it off him, asks if phylacteries are flame resistant, and wants to torch it. Walker refuses and will give it only to Carlkin.
The party treats it as a possible phylactery that should be ruled out, not destroyed, until they have eyes on the owner.

Grixto.existing: A mobile antagonist who hides his phylactery among mundane possessions.
notes: Walker names Grixto as the one who might be influencing him or Glimmen through the helmet.

Phylactery.existing: A vessel containing a lich's soul.
notes: Glimmen asks whether phylacteries are flame resistant. Walker says not necessarily.

Sylan warns that if the owner senses the phylactery destroyed, he will make another before they can stop him. Walker agrees to destroy it only with eyes on the owner. Sylan says they can still try to rule the helmet out without destroying it.
quotesThemes: If he senses that the phylactery is destroyed, he'll just make another one.

Golden fire.existing: The life force of Walker's gold dragon rider bond.
notes: Glimmen says Walker's internal fire can spread and protect her because they have bonded. She has already gone over mind control with him in that context.

Dana.existing: Half-elf cleric, most knowledgeable of the group.
notes: She switches to Draconic to ask Glimmen whether the helmet has changed Walker in any odd way.
She calls lighting Walker on fire a fun afternoon and asks whether he is fire retardant.
She tells Gerk and Sylan both to stay home from the Carlkin visit, then accepts Sylan's good-cop/bad-cop split.
She forbids doors to empty dimensions, abyssal monsters, and opening doors on moving vehicles.
She tells Gerk that meditation is quieting the mind the way he focuses to open a door, that the rage still matters if it is channeled, and that the doors are a separate focus.
Sylan asks her to notify Carlkin that they are returning today because they are not within 500 feet.
personality: Uses Glimmen as the person who would notice influence on Walker.
Wants Gerk's rage kept and aimed, not replaced by calm.
quotesThemes: I just really want to make sure that he's not being influenced.
We need the rage. The rage is the whole thing, but the rage needs to be channeled appropriately and the doors are an entirely separate ability to focus.
Please no doors to nothing dimensions. Please no abyssal monsters. No opening doors on moving vehicles.

notes: He argues against destroying a suspected phylactery before they find its owner, because the owner would make another, and says they can still rule the helmet out.
He offers Carlkin as a private appointment if Walker will not remove the helmet in front of the group.
He thinks Gerk should not make the Carlkin visit and doubts he should go either, then proposes they do good cop and bad cop while the others see Carlkin.
He tells Walker that training has let Gerk manipulate doors a little better, but that Gerk needs more work, and he suggests Gerk try raging on a door next training.
He heads for New Navel and asks Dana to warn Carlkin. He says the last visit had no appointment, they opened a portal to the abyss, and he broke Carlkin's floor.
quotesThemes: If it is the phylactery, we should not destroy it immediately and find him first.
That doesn't mean we can't rule it out.

notes: He says Carlkin is in a bad way and that the others should not walk in on him.
Sylan says recent training let Gerk manipulate doors a little better, with more work still needed.

The trainer pokes him, calls him strong of body and lacking in mind, and compares him to an oak sapling whose mind they will draw out. Gerk asks Ord if he is being insulted and says getting bigger would be inconvenient.
He does not know what meditation is. He says a door opens to the abyss only if he thinks about nothing, and that he focuses in order to open doors.
He thinks raging while opening a door would go poorly. On the seventeen-foot door, he says he only tried to open it harder.
Dana assigns him to stay off the Carlkin visit. Sylan drafts him as bad cop, and Ord questions how that works if Gerk cannot threaten anyone.
personality: Treats the sapling remark as a possible insult, then laughs it off.
Says he does not have a quiet mind.
Wants the rage kept; he is afraid of being pushed into something that gets him killed.
quotesThemes: You don't want to walk in there. He's kinda bad right now.
No, that's only if I think about nothing.
I think if I think about raging while I open a door, that seems like it'd probably go poorly.
I just tried to open it harder.

notes: She agrees they should test whether Walker is fireproof and starts a tinderbox under his arm.
quotesThemes: I think we should test that theory.

Carlkin.existing: Turtle-like person in New Navel; previously agreed to examine the helm by appointment.
notes: Walker will hand him the helmet for examination and will not give it to the party.
Gerk says he is in a bad way right now and not to walk in. Ord says he is not available. Dana tells Gerk and Sylan to stay home from the visit.

Sylan says the last visit had no appointment: they barged in, opened a portal to the abyss, and Sylan broke the floor, so Carlkin wants warning. Sylan asks Dana to notify him because they are not within 500 feet. Sylan is heading to New Navel.

After Sylan says Gerk needs more door training, he says that makes two students and that he is willing to train them. He tells Walker to take the helmet to be investigated and then return to training.
He looks half-elf and stands about 5'10" to 5'11". He has an ancient copper-colored dragon. Gerk already knew about the dragon and did not know this height.
He pokes Gerk in the midriff and says Gerk is strong of body but his mind is lacking, and that they will work that out of him.
He says it is not an insult: one does not insult an oak tree as a sapling, because one day it will be more. He taps Gerk's chest and says not to look for that growth in the body but in the mind.
He says Walker needs help meditating and asks whether Gerk has ever meditated.
personality: Teacherly and blunt. He frames criticism as cultivation rather than an insult.
He is focused on the mind and on meditation.
quotesThemes: You seem to be strong of body, but your mind seems to be lacking. We will work that out of you.
One does not insult an oak tree as a sapling. They just know one day it'll be more.
Not big in here. But big in there, your mind, boy.
Walker needs some help meditating.

Doorway.existing: Gerk's doorway ability, a supernatural passage between locations.
notes: Sylan says training has let Gerk manipulate the doors a little better, and that he is on the right path but needs more work.
Dana says an unfocused door opens into the abyss and lets giant monsters out. Gerk says that happens only if he thinks about nothing, and that focus is what he uses to aim a door.
Dana says door-opening is a separate focus from rage. Gerk expects raging while opening a door to go poorly. He describes the seventeen-foot door as him trying to open it harder.
Dana's conditions for Gerk going off on his own: no doors to empty dimensions, no abyssal monsters, and no opening doors on moving vehicles.

openQuestions: Is Walker's helmet a phylactery, and is it influencing him? Glimmen still wants a burn test; Walker will only let Carlkin examine it.

newTerms.name: Unnamed half-elf trainer
notes: A man who looks half-elf, about 5'10" to 5'11", with an ancient copper-colored dragon. He offers to train Walker in meditation and Gerk in mind, and he already knows Walker well enough to send him off with the helmet and expect him back.
